name: frunchy
title: Frunchy
description: Your anime identity in numbers: Frunchy turns your Crunchyroll watch history into statistics you can share.
notes: Frunchy signs people in through Umbral, so install Umbral first (its own template), claim it, and in Umbral's admin create a web application with the redirect URI https://{{domain}}/signin-umbral: its client ID and secret are what you typed here. First account: on its first start Frunchy writes a one-time setup invite to its log; open the app's Logs, find the line "Invite", then sign in at https://{{domain}}/signin with Umbral and paste it. That account is an operator; to make it the root operator (who can open sign-ups), set Frunchy__RootOperator to its username on the Variables page. Sign-up is by invite until then. For studios, genres and seasons, add Frunchy__Mal__ClientId (a client ID from myanimelist.net/apiconfig) on the Variables page. Then install the Frunchy browser extension and connect it with the sync key from your account page. Postgres is backed up every day at 03:00 UTC, keeping 14. The data-protection key Caravana made is kept as a secret: losing it only signs everyone out.
